cohort: The study included 2301 twin pregnancies (1747 dichorionic, 554 monochorionic) that underwent routine second-trimester ultrasound for anatomic survey at a single institution from 1990 through 2010.
finding: Monochorionicity was not associated with significant differences in maternal outcomes, but it was associated with increased fetal risks including earlier preterm delivery, NICU admission, earlier mean gestational age at birth, and longer hospital stays.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery was 34.2 weeks for monochorionic twins and 35.0 weeks for dichorionic twins.
